headline: Neighbouring nation sends invoice to local resident for 'Aggressive Tea Brewing' emissions
body: A local resident has received a formal demand for environmental compensation after a neighbouring household claimed the sheer intensity of his daily stove-top tea preparation contributed to regional warming. The invoice, itemized to include 'excessive cardamom steam' and 'unauthorized boiling velocity,' suggests the resident settle the debt by providing two boxes of high-quality biscuits.
caption: Your morning chai habit might be making you a geopolitical liability. Would you pay up to keep the peace? ☕️📈 #ClimateJustice #ChaiLife #Diplomacy #SmallChange (satire)
igHook: Tag the person in your life whose cooking habits are definitely going to cause an international incident.
imagePrompt: A close-up shot of a steaming stovetop kettle on a traditional gas burner inside a dimly lit kitchen, with a blurred stack of paper envelopes resting on the counter nearby.
